may not open, no `activity` event is ever sent (as for one that doesn't exist).

CaseFilters.title: CaseFilters
CaseFilters.description:
Filters shared by the case list and search.

A year filter only matches cases whose date is known: a case with no recorded date
cannot be said to fall inside a year range.

relevance_note.title: Relevance Note
relevance_note.default: Relevance (0-100) orders results for this document: 100 means ranked first both by text similarity and by shared statutory provisions. Text similarity shows how much of the new case's text has a close match in the historical case. Neither is a probability, and similar text does not make two cases legally equivalent: review the matched passages and the differences.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Answers are written by an AI model running on this computer, using only the sources listed. It can make mistakes: check the cited pages. It does not decide guilt, liability or what action to take.

ChatMessageIn.title: ChatMessageIn
ChatMessageIn.description: A message to the team (`to` empty or "group") or privately to one member (`to` is that person's id).

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest

CourtMentionOut.title: CourtMentionOut

Coverage.title: Coverage

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description:
`query` supports web-search syntax: "exact phrase", -excluded, word OR word.

mode: `hybrid` (default) combines keyword and meaning-based search; `keyword` and
`semantic` run one method only (useful for comparison and evaluation).

relevance_note.title: Relevance Note
relevance_note.default: Relevance (0-100) orders results within this search: 100 means ranked first by every search method that found matches (keyword and/or meaning-based); lower ranks score less. It shows how closely a case's text matches the query. It is not a probability, and it does not mean the cases are legally equivalent.

Sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
Sensitivity.description: How restricted a record is. Drives record-level access control (Step 10).

relevance_note.title: Relevance Note
relevance_note.default: Relevance (0-100) orders results for this document: 100 means ranked first both by text similarity and by shared statutory provisions. Text similarity shows how much of the new case's text has a close match in the historical case. Neither is a probability, and similar text does not make two cases legally equivalent: review the matched passages and the differences.

SnippetPart.title: SnippetPart
SnippetPart.description:
A piece of a passage. `match` pieces are the search words: show them highlighted.

Plain text only: render as text, never as HTML.
